The third path shows Ligandrol interacting with the Androgen receptor, which is targeted by Afimoxifene, and Afimoxifene also targets Protein kinase C beta type. These findings collectively indicate that Ligandrol may influence Protein kinase C beta type through different molecular mechanisms, possibly involving various signaling pathways.
